comment: DRIVE and CHAR are both inert on the default settings. ChanOutCleanEngine::process takes drive but computes driveAmount = (outputMode == 1) ? drive * 0.1f : 0.0f (src/ChanOutCleanEngine.hpp:117-125), so in Master Output mode, which is the default, the knob does nothing; in Channel Output mode full drive is a gain of 1.1, about 0.83dB. The clean engine's process() takes no character argument at all (src/ChanOut.cpp:845-847), so CHAR is read by nothing on the Standard engine. The pan law is the other way round from the README, which says Master is linear and Channel is equal power: applyPan uses cos/sin in both modes and multiplies by sqrt(2) only in Channel mode, so Master loses 3dB at centre and Channel is unity at centre (src/ChanOut.cpp, applyPan). The character engines are selected by four custom squares as well as by the menu. DISPLAY_ENABLE_PARAM has no ParamWidget and cannot be clicked for help. The mute and dim slews are both 125 units per second.
